Ability.Name: -- MRC Heal Engine --
Ability.Lua: -- MRC: seleccion automatica compatible con PQR_CustomTarget. local function MRC_HP(unit) if not UnitExists(unit) or UnitIsDeadOrGhost(unit) or not UnitIsConnected(unit) then return nil end local maximum=UnitHealthMax(unit) if not maximum or maximum<=0 then return nil end return 100*UnitHealth(unit)/maximum end local function MRC_InRange(unit) if unit=="player" then return true end local r=UnitInRange(unit) return r==1 or r==true end local best="player" local bestHP=MRC_HP("player") or 100 local count=GetNumRaidMembers() if count and count>0 then for i=1,count do local u="raid"..i local hp=MRC_HP(u) if hp and UnitCanAssist("player",u) and MRC_InRange(u) and hp<bestHP then best,bestHP=u,hp end end else count=GetNumPartyMembers() or 0 for i=1,count do local u="party"..i local hp=MRC_HP(u) if hp and UnitCanAssist("player",u) and MRC_InRange(u) and hp<bestHP then best,bestHP=u,hp end end end PQR_CustomTarget=best PQR_CustomTargetHP=bestHP -- Mantenimiento del tanque en foco. Solo intenta hechizos que el personaje ya conoce. if UnitExists("focus") and not UnitIsDeadOrGhost("focus") and UnitCanAssist("player","focus") then local buffs={{id=53563,refresh=10},{id=53601,refresh=5}} for _,b in ipairs(buffs) do local spell=GetSpellInfo(b.id) if spell and IsUsableSpell(spell) and IsSpellInRange(spell,"focus")==1 then local expires=0 for j=1,40 do local n,_,_,_,_,_,expiration,_,_,_,sid=UnitBuff("focus",j) if not n then break end if sid==b.id then expires=expiration or 0; break end end if expires==0 or expires-GetTime()<b.refresh then CastSpellByName(spell,"focus") return true end end end end return false

Ability.Name: -- MRC Smart Heal --
Ability.Lua: -- Cura al aliado seleccionado por MRC Heal Engine sin cambiar el target del jugador. local unit=PQR_CustomTarget local hp=PQR_CustomTargetHP if not unit or not UnitExists(unit) or UnitIsDeadOrGhost(unit) or not hp then return false end local spells={ {id=48825,threshold=75}, -- Choque Sagrado {id=48785,threshold=58}, -- Destello de Luz {id=48782,threshold=88} -- Luz Sagrada } for _,entry in ipairs(spells) do local name=GetSpellInfo(entry.id) if name and hp<=entry.threshold and IsUsableSpell(name) and IsSpellInRange(name,unit)==1 then local start,duration=GetSpellCooldown(entry.id) if not start or duration==0 or start+duration<=GetTime() then CastSpellByName(name,unit) return true end end end return false

Ability.Name: -- MRC Control --
Ability.Lua: if not MRC then MRC={} end if IsLeftControlKeyDown() and not MRC.ctrl then MRC.ctrl=true; StopRota=not StopRota; PQR_WriteToChat(StopRota and "MRC pausado" or "MRC activo") elseif not IsLeftControlKeyDown() then MRC.ctrl=false end return false
